shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Soratha.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਨਾਰੀ ਜੂਆ ਅਸਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਮਦਰਾ ਜਾਨ॥
verses.translit_en: paranaaree jooaa asat choree madharaa jaan||

en.bdb: Know another's women, gambling, speaking falseness, theft, and alcohol;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚ ਐਂਬ ਯੇ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਸੁ ਸਿੰਘ ਸੁਜਾਨ॥੫੮॥
verses.translit_en: paa(n)ch aai(n)b ye jagat mai tajai su si(n)gh sujaan||58||

en.bdb: These are five Aibs (evil vices) of this world, the Singh who rejects them is wise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਕੋ ਪਾਇ ਸਿੰਘ ਜਿਉਂ ਗਰਜੈ॥
verses.translit_en: ran ko pai si(n)gh jiau(n) garajai||

en.bdb: In the battlefield the Singh must thunderously roar.
Fighting face to face he puts cease to and ends the invaders.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਭਾਗੇ॥
verses.translit_en: ran ko jai na kabahoo(n) bhaage||

en.bdb: Never flee the battlefield;
Fight the Turk, whether awake or asleep.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ॥
verses.translit_en: chhatree karam su dhiraR kar dhaarai||

en.bdb: Enact the deeds of a Kshatriya (warrior) with firm determination;
Crying *Kill! Kill* in the battlefield.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਰੈ ਨ ਨੈਕੁ ਨਿਡਰ ਹੋਇ ਲਰੇ॥
verses.translit_en: ddarai na naik niddar hoi lare||

en.bdb: Have not even a drop of fear, fight fearlessly.
Imbue *I shall kill the enemy* in your very spirit.
Those who loose their life in battle;
They shall certainly attain paradise.
He who defeats the enemy in battle;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮੋਂ ਜਸ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੋ ਤਬਹੂੰ॥੬੪॥
verses.translit_en: jag mo(n) jas paaveh go tabahoo(n)||64||

en.bdb: Shall have his glory resounding throughout the entire world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਜੁਧ ਮਹਾਂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹ ਹੋਈ॥
verses.translit_en: taa(n) te judh mahaa(n) dhiraRh hoiee||

en.bdb: Therefore, stand firm in even the greatest of wars.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਮੋ ਤਜਿ ਨਹਿ ਭਾਗੈ ਸੋਈ॥੬੫॥
verses.translit_en: ran mo taj neh bhaagai soiee||65||

en.bdb: Never turn and flee from the field of battle.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਰਣ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਡਰੈ॥
verses.translit_en: jo kabahoo(n) ran te man ddarai||

en.bdb: If one is unworthy of the battlefield;
May he remain in agriculture or any other work.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰ ਵਰਨ ਮੋ ਨਰ ਹੈਂ ਜੇਤੇ॥
verses.translit_en: chaar varan mo nar hai(n) jete||

en.bdb: To all the men of all four Varnas;
I direct these teachings to them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਂ ਕਿਉ ਂ ਕਰ ਤਿਨ ਸਿੰਘ ਬਨਾਵੈ॥
verses.translit_en: jiau (n) kiau (n) kar tin si(n)gh banaavai||

en.bdb: He who makes others Singhs;
should not show pride in his achievement.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਮਨ ਦੇਈ॥
verses.translit_en: kuTa(n)b maeh neh at man dheiee||

en.bdb: Do not attach yourself wholly to your family;
Continuously love and serve the Guru.
Keep faith in the destiny which has been given to you;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਧਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਾਖੈ॥੭੦॥
verses.translit_en: at dhan tirasanaa man te naakhai||70||

en.bdb: Restrain yourself from developing a thirst for excessive wealth.
If one cleans his heart, blessings will showered upon him.
Fiercely aggressive on the battlefield, yet he is tranquil at home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਲ ਬਚਨ ਮਨ ਰਿਜ ਮੁਖ ਮੀਠਾ॥
verses.translit_en: saral bachan man rij mukh meeThaa||

en.bdb: Simple of speech, of upright spirit, and of sweet words:
He will be recognized as devoted to the Guru.
It is the grace of friendship;
to show endless love.
Never forsake the way of humility.
Flee from the wicked people.
There is no happiness in the company of the wicked people;
Reflect on this within your mind.
lust, anger, greed, intoxication, and pride;
The wise will restrict these.
Firmly uphold humility, Bibek (wisdom) and Righteousness.
Never utter a word of falseness.
